scenario.topic: Decide which farmers market stall the co-op should rent

options.name: Corner Stall near Entrance
options.upside: High foot traffic due to proximity to entrance
options.concern: Rental cost is higher than some other stalls

options.name: Central Aisle Stall
options.upside: Moderate rental cost with good visibility
options.concern: No utilities included, may require additional setup

options.name: Back Row Stall
options.upside: Largest stall size with water access
options.concern: Lower foot traffic due to location at back

options.name: Sidewalk Stall Outside Market
options.upside: Access to both electricity and water utilities
options.concern: Exposure to weather may affect setup and sales

shared_context: The co-op must select one farmers market stall to rent for the upcoming season. Each stall varies in size, location within the market, rental cost, and access to utilities, all important factors for the co-op's operations and customer reach.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a community organizer focused on maximizing co-op visibility and customer engagement.
personas.private_goal: Secure the stall with the highest foot traffic to boost co-op sales and awareness.

A.reason_for: Located near the main entrance with high foot traffic and includes electricity, ideal for attracting customers.

B.reason_for: Moderate rental cost and decent visibility in the middle aisle.
B.reason_against: No utilities included, which complicates setup and operations.

C.reason_for: Largest stall size with water access could be useful for some operations.
C.reason_against: Located at the back with lower foot traffic, reducing customer reach.

D.reason_for: Good utility access with electricity and water, and moderate rental cost.
D.reason_against: Exposure to weather could negatively impact sales and setup.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a pragmatic co-op member focused on balancing cost and operational efficiency.
personas.private_goal: Find a cost-effective stall that still offers reasonable visibility and minimal extra setup.

A.reason_for: High foot traffic is attractive for sales.
A.reason_against: Rental cost is the highest, which strains the budget.

B.reason_for: Lower rental cost with decent location and good visibility balances budget and exposure.

C.reason_for: Lowest rental cost and largest size with water access.
C.reason_against: Back row location means less customer traffic.

D.reason_for: Utilities included and moderate cost make it a practical choice.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is an experienced vendor who values utility access and stall protection for product quality.
personas.private_goal: Choose a stall with reliable utilities and protection to ensure smooth daily operations.

A.reason_for: Close to entrance with electricity included, supporting good sales and product display.
A.reason_against: Higher rental cost and no water access.

B.reason_for: Affordable and centrally located for visibility.
B.reason_against: No utilities included, increasing setup complexity.

C.reason_against: Back row location limits customer exposure.

D.reason_for: Includes both electricity and water, essential for operations, despite weather exposure risk.

acceptance_reasons.D: Good utility access with electricity and water, and moderate rental cost.

acceptance_reasons.A: Close to entrance with electricity included, supporting good sales and product display.
